messages:
jamie: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — root cause was auth token TTL rollover at our cloud identity provider that caused transient 401s against model-registry. The incident surface looked like: increased 401s, cache thrash, and then downstream timeouts.

alex: Ack. Do we have a timeline for when the provider rotated keys? can we get their audit logs? :eyes:

maria: Provider says rotation started 03/18 02:12 UTC and completed by 02:18 UTC. They missed our expiration buffer by ~30s. I pulled their audit link: https://idp.example.com/audit/rotations/03-18

carl: From our side the model-registry client retries weren't backoff-friendly — we had tight retry loops that amplified load. Need to change to jittered exponential backoff.

leah: Action list proposal: 1) Add local short-lived fallback token + validation (owner: @maria, ETA: 2026-03-27) 2) Runbook update for provider rotations + detection (owner: @carl, ETA: 2026-03-24) 3) Automated alert on sudden rise of 401s + cache miss spikes (owner: @alex, ETA: 2026-03-23) 4) Add simulated rotation test to infra-cicd (owner: @jamie, ETA: 2026-04-03). Thoughts?

oncall-bot: Note: scheduled maintenance window created for runbook revision on 2026-03-24 09:00 UTC by jamie.

jamie: I like those. Small edits: fallback token should be sealed in KMS, with a short TTL and revoked once provider rotation completes. Also add a manual rollback path for any model-registry client release.

alex: For alerting, I suggest thresholds: 401 rate > 0.5% over 5m AND cache miss spike > 3x baseline. Alert should page oncall and create an incident channel. I can land the Prom rule and dashboard.

maria: On fallback token: suggested implementation outline: generate fallback token via internal auth service, store in KMS, and serve via in-memory cache with TTL=90s. When provider rotation starts, rotate fallback to smaller TTL and surface hook to revoke. Snippet for validation check: 

```
// pseudo
if (resp.status == 401) {
  if (fallbackToken.available()) retryWith(fallbackToken);
  else backoffAndAlert();
}
```

carl: Runbook items to add: detection checks, pre-rotation sanity test (call registry with ephemeral creds), and a provider contact checklist (pager numbers + escalation). I'll draft and put a PR to infra-runbooks before EOD Wed.

leah: Also flagging recurring pattern: we saw similar auth rotation impacts in 2025-11 and again in 2026-01 albeit smaller. We should ask provider for a formal SLA on rotation notifications and an option for a staged key rollout. I'll reach out to partner manager. (owner: @leah, ETA: 2026-03-30)

sre-bot: Incident correlation query ran: matched 2 previous incidents with auth rotations (ids: 2025-11-08-401, 2026-01-14-401). Recommend scheduling quarterly tabletop with provider.

jamie: Good catch, @leah. Also add a test to our canary pipeline that simulates a 401 flood and verifies fallback + retry behaviour. This should be part of the gate for any model-registry client change.

alex: I'll open a PR with Prom alert + dashboard tiles today. Once that's merged, I can add an automated runbook link in the alert.

maria: WIP: fallback token prototype in my branch: github.com/redwood/model-registry/branches/fallback-token-proto. I'll post the design doc in the incident doc shortly.

carl: Draft runbook PR: https://git.redwood/infradocs/runbooks/pulls/142 — feedback welcome.

leah: Owners recap: maria=fallback token prototype + KMS flow, carl=runbook + pre-rotation tests, alex=alerting + dashboard, jamie=canary test + client gate, leah=vendor SLA escalation. Please add any missing owners.

jamie: Missing item: add a litmus test for cache thrash (measure eviction rate and circuit-breaker trips). I'll own the metric definition, ETA: 2026-03-26.

alex: Got it. I also propose a temporary traffic-routing policy: during provider rotations route model-registry auth calls to a pool with higher retry budgets and circuit breakers tuned conservatively. We can gate this behind a feature flag. (owner: alex, ETA: 2026-03-29)

maria: Agree. Also will add unit + integration tests for fallback path.

leah: Can everyone drop short status updates in this thread by EOD Friday so we can close the postmortem action tracker? :white_check_mark:

jamie: Will do. Thanks everyone.

oncall-bot: Reminder: next oncall rotation on 2026-03-25.

sre-bot: Archived incident summary will be attached to the postmortem doc once all action items check as done.
__notes: Generated synthetic Slack thread focused on vendor auth rotation mitigations and postmortem action tracking. Messages are short and in Slack style per agents.md. All fields are strings or list of strings.
